items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: I lined up with, uh, a very famous trumpet player... His name was P.G. Lowry.

ctx.x: They had the brass bands when you were a boy. Uh-huh.

You know, because I had a taste of that myself after I began running around the country. That was one of my first trips. I went away with an outfit that was organized in St. Louis. And, uh, we traveled around the country for a while and had the misfortune of being stranded. And from there, we- I lined up with, uh, a very famous trumpet player we had by the- who was, at that time, with the Four Point Ring Brothers Circus. His name was P.G. Lowry.
